notes: Eclipse Loop 1.0.5 - 6-stem splitting (adds Guitar and Piano; right-click SPLIT STEMS to pick 4 or 6, both AI models bundled), mixer VU meters and dB readouts on every strip, spacebar transport in the mixer, a WIDTH stereo widener, and selection-based waveform editing (delete/duplicate/reverse/gain). TIME SHIFT effects now apply to the loop you're actually playing instead of the whole file. Fixes: bar-count changes knocking patterns off the beat, loop auto-framing on load, DRAG MIDI, sample-editor playhead and LOOP, and static when loading a 44.1 kHz loop into a 48 kHz session.
